title: Face and five-sided pyramid at Cydonia Mensa

tellings.quote: we were looking at Cydonia Mensa, which is a site where there's the face and then there's a nearby like 5 mi away there's a five-sided pyramid that NASA never shows that picture of the face beside the pyramid together in any of their public photos because it becomes obvious.

plain: On a part of Mars called Cydonia Mensa there is a formation that looks like a face, and about five miles from it a five-sided pyramid, according to the physicist Dr. John Brandenburg, who sums this up from images dated to 1976 without naming a particular source. He says NASA, the US space agency, never shows the face and the pyramid side by side in its public photos "because it becomes obvious." If he is right, it would point to built structures on Mars and a space agency choosing not to draw attention to them.
